title: Jaxson Smith-Njigba, Leonard Williams listed as limited practice participants again on Tuesday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jaxson Smith-Njigba, Leonard Williams listed as limited practice participants again on Tuesday
sources.description: The Seahawks released another estimated practice report on Tuesday and it didn't feature a change in status for wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba or defensive tackle Leonard Williams.
